requirement_statement: Reviewed current geometry for the OT.02 source-model spatial units used to locate and identify profile/run context.
acceptance_criteria: Admit a specific current geometry/version with stable spatial-unit IDs, provenance, review date and enough area/feature metadata to distinguish administrative area from model units.
blocking_reason: Resolved for current peilgebied spatial identity: the owner status-4 OT.02 polygon is persisted and cross-checked. This does not resolve affected compaction area or any later subdivision into source-model units.
next_action: Proceed to DR_SM_PROFILE using the admitted OT.02 polygon as the sampling domain; re-open this geometry gate if the owner status or polygon changes.
request_notes: Admission is limited to peilgebied geometry. The geometry-derived area is about 1496.52 ha and corroborates the 1497-ha administrative benchmark; source attribute GPGOPPVL=1506 is not admitted as geometry area and none of these values is affected compaction area.

requirement_statement: Depth-resolved profile/layer context for the selected source-model units, including layer geometry and relevant intrinsic properties.
acceptance_criteria: Persist source/profile IDs, depth intervals, provenance and the intrinsic properties needed by the selected model; clearly label derived/modal attributes versus direct measurements.
blocking_reason: Resolved for bounded OT.02 profile identity and modal layer context: all eight profiles detected by the two shifted 500 m screenings are persisted with BOFEK2020 crosswalk and full 0-120 cm layer definitions. Exact areal weighting and current compaction state remain outside this admission.
next_action: Proceed to DR_SM_CURRENT_STATE using the admitted eight-profile context basis; acquire or qualify dated current compaction-state evidence without substituting modal SoilPhys density.
request_notes: Admission covers profile identity/layer context only. Screening fractions are diagnostics, not exact area weights. modal_bulk_density_g_cm3 is deliberately separate from soil_state.bulk_density_g_cm3.

requirement_statement: Current depth-resolved soil/compaction state for each selected profile/layer at the state variables required by the source model.
acceptance_criteria: Provide dated current-state evidence or a qualified derivation with layer-level provenance; keep intrinsic profile properties separate from state variables and retain uncertainty/derivation status.
blocking_reason: Available screening information does not establish a measured or otherwise admitted current compaction state.
next_action: Identify the current-state measurement or defensible derivation route and qualify it for the selected profiles.
request_notes: API/modal bulk density is not automatically current anthropogenic compaction.

requirement_statement: Matched reference soil state for each current profile/state, constructed for the explicit causal question.
acceptance_criteria: Document reference construction, evidence and rationale at compatible profile/layer grain; preserve controlled dimensions and record which state variables differ from CURRENT.
blocking_reason: The reference concept is theoretically qualified but no Tollebeek-specific reference state is admitted.
next_action: Define candidate reference-construction options only after the current profile/state is fixed, then qualify one for the intended attribution use.
request_notes: REFERENCE is not synonymous with pristine, zero traffic or an arbitrary low bulk density.

requirement_statement: Current drainage configuration relevant to the selected source-model units and event, including geometry/control parameters required by the chosen representation.
acceptance_criteria: Admit current drainage-system evidence or an explicitly qualified derivation for the selected units; identify configuration version, spatial applicability and model parameter mapping.
blocking_reason: Historical Noordoostpolder settings are method priors only and cannot serve as current OT.02 calibration.
next_action: Acquire current drainage GIS/asset/design information for the selected units and reconcile it with the intended model representation.
request_notes: Do not copy 100 d or 30 d historical resistances as current defaults.

requirement_statement: Actual meteorological forcing for the event or simulation window selected for the first paired source-model experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Persist source, timestamps, timezone, units, temporal resolution, missing-data/QC handling and exact window; resolution must be reviewed for the runoff question.
blocking_reason: Method evidence supports sub-daily/hourly forcing as a baseline, but no concrete Tollebeek event series has been admitted.
next_action: Select a defensible first event/window and acquire the corresponding observed forcing with provenance and QC metadata.
request_notes: Hourly is not asserted to be universally sufficient.

requirement_statement: Initial hydrological state or reproducible warm-up protocol shared by the matched CURRENT and REFERENCE runs unless the scientific design explicitly requires otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Define and persist the initial-state variables or warm-up procedure, provenance and equality/equivalence rule across the pair; unknown initial conditions must remain explicit.
blocking_reason: No admitted event-specific groundwater/soil-water initial state or qualified warm-up protocol exists in the canonical project state.
next_action: Choose the event first, then identify observed initial-state data or define a reviewable warm-up protocol without convenience defaults.
request_notes: A target surface-water level is not an initial groundwater profile.

requirement_statement: Managed groundwater/surface-water boundary representation for the selected profiles and event, including the control semantics that must remain matched across CURRENT and REFERENCE runs.
acceptance_criteria: Document the boundary formulation, data source/control rule, event applicability and model mapping; demonstrate that the paired runs use identical or explicitly equivalent boundary semantics.
blocking_reason: The managed-system nature and target level are known, but exact event control/boundary behaviour is not admitted.
next_action: Acquire or define reviewable event control/boundary evidence and map it explicitly into the selected model configuration.
request_notes: Do not default OT.02 to free drainage or equate target level with total dynamic head.

requirement_statement: Land-use/crop context applicable to the selected spatial units and simulation period where the source model response depends on vegetation/crop state.
acceptance_criteria: Record the land-use/crop identity, period and provenance at the grain required by the model; keep it identical across a simple soil-state attribution pair unless intentionally part of the research question.
blocking_reason: No Tollebeek-specific land-use/crop input has been admitted for the first source-model pair.
next_action: After spatial-unit selection, acquire the relevant land-use/crop context for the chosen event/window and review its model mapping.
request_notes: Do not silently choose a representative crop for the whole administrative area.

requirement_statement: Pinned source-model implementation/version and explicit numerical/model configuration used by both members of the CURRENT/REFERENCE pair.
acceptance_criteria: Record executable/model authority, version/commit where applicable, configuration ID and all controlled dimensions required to reproduce the pair; CURRENT and REFERENCE must differ only in the admitted state contrast for simple attribution.
blocking_reason: The project architecture defines model_configuration but no concrete source-model execution authority/configuration has been admitted for this experiment.
next_action: Select and pin the source-model implementation only after the input contract is reviewed; then register the exact configuration before running the pair.
request_notes: This request does not choose SWAP version or numerical defaults on behalf of the scientific review.
